Hi Lena —

Thanks again for the great interview last week. Attached is the first draft of the customer spotlight we discussed. Two quick asks as you review: 

- Please confirm the one-line customer quote on page 1 (we've pulled a short sentence from your notes). If you'd prefer different wording or an attribution line, let us know.
- We included a high-level cost reduction figure and a median inference latency figure under "Results." Can you confirm those numbers (we pulled from the PoC report): 68% cost reduction and median 180ms p50 latency? If either needs to be softened (e.g., "up to") or footnoted, say the word.

If possible, could you return any redlines or a single-marked version by end of day July 9 so we can keep to our publish calendar? If legal wants to review, feel free to loop them in (we've cc'd your marketing contact in prior threads).

Appreciate it — we want to be precise here and give Synergy full control of the final quote.

Best,
Rafael

Rafael —

Thanks for the draft and for capturing our story. We made some inline redlines (attached) and a couple of substantive requests: 

1) Quote: please replace the quote on page 1 with this exact wording and attribution: 

"Redwood reduced our end-to-end inference cost by 68% while preserving model response quality." — Ana Moreno, Director of Engineering, Synergy Health

2) Results section: the "median 180ms p50 latency" reads optimistic for our production traffic. For accuracy, please change to "median ~200–220ms p50 latency (observed during production traffic)" or similar wording — we can provide the exact Grafana snapshot if you want.

3) Please remove the sentence that says "99.99% uptime" — that is not a contractually guaranteed SLA for this deployment.

Overall we're fine with publication once the above changes are in place and legal signs off on the final wording. I've cc'd legal for visibility; they'll review the redlines in the doc.

Best,
Lena

Lena Ortiz
Director, Cloud Engineering | Synergy Health

Thanks for the ping. Quick technical confirmation after re-running the PoC summary: 

- The 68% number is the observed cost reduction versus your baseline CPU-hosted RAG pipeline configured in March. To be conservative and avoid implying a guaranteed outcome across customers, I suggest using the phrase "up to 68%" or "as much as 68%". If Synergy prefers the exact wording they provided, we can publish it verbatim but we should include a short parenthetical note that the figure reflects the observed PoC delta.

- Latency: the p50 ~180ms figure is the tail of our PoC sampling; under production variability we observed median values in the 200–220ms band. Suggested text: "median ~200–220ms p50 latency (production traffic)."

- Legal: no contract language included. We removed the SLA claim.

I've attached the small cost model we used to calculate the percentage so Synergy can verify.

Happy to jump on a quick call if useful.

Ben

Ben Carter
Principal Product Manager, Inference Platform | Redwood Inference
